visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot introduces a steaming bowl of fish soup, showing sliced green sponge gourd, translucent white radish, and open clams in a clear broth. The setting is a bright indoor kitchen with soft lighting. Text overlays provide a title in Traditional Chinese. (2) A middle-aged woman with short, reddish-brown hair is shown from the head and shoulders, wearing a dark apron. She tastes the soup from a spoon, closing her eyes with a smile of satisfaction. The background shows kitchen shelves with spices. (3) The camera focuses on hands using a white peeler to remove the skin from a large white radish on a light-colored cutting board. The radish is then cut into sections and sliced into thin, flat pieces. (4) A long, ridged green sponge gourd is peeled in a metal tray, then moved to the cutting board where it is sliced into thick, crescent-shaped pieces. The lighting is bright and even. (5) Garlic cloves are placed on the board and smashed using the bottom of a metal pitcher, then finely minced with a chef's knife. (6) A black frying pan is placed on an induction cooktop. Hands pour oil from a pink bottle and add the minced garlic, which sizzles. The loofah pieces are added and stirred with a black spatula. (7) White radish slices are added to the pan and mixed with the loofah. Hot water is poured from a glass measuring cup into the pan until the vegetables are partially submerged. (8) A red pot of boiling water is shown next to the pan. A metal mesh strainer containing white noodles is lowered into the water. (9) Clams are added to the simmering vegetable soup in the pan using the strainer. The noodles are lifted out of the red pot, showing they are cooked. (10) Fresh, silver-skinned fish slices are carefully placed on top of the simmering vegetables. Salt and liquid seasoning are added. (11) The final dish is presented in a white bowl with a red rim. The woman is shown again eating the noodles and soup, looking very happy in the warm indoor light.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 天冷的時候來一碗❤️ 絲瓜蘿蔔鱸魚湯. [Variety]: 自然鮮甜好滋味！. (2) [Variety]: 幸福的滋味❤️. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen. (3) [Subtitle]: 白蘿蔔先刨掉兩三層皮. (4) [Subtitle]: 去掉頭尾 切成三等份. (5) [Subtitle]: 取用三份之一份量 剩下的冰箱保存. (6) [Subtitle]: 剖半再剖半. (7) [Subtitle]: 切成薄片. (8) [Subtitle]: 薄片烹煮的時間 會比較短一點. (9) [Subtitle]: 絲瓜刨去外皮. (10) [Subtitle]: 去掉頭尾. (11) [Subtitle]: 剖半再剖半. (12) [Subtitle]: 切成厚片. (13) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來 剁成蒜末. (14) [Subtitle]: 放入橄欖油、蒜末爆香. (15) [Subtitle]: 等編出香味. (16) [Subtitle]: 放入絲瓜炒香. (17) [Subtitle]: 表面稍微煸香. (18) [Subtitle]: 快速翻炒均勻. (19) [Subtitle]: 一點胡椒調味. (20) [Subtitle]: 接著放入白蘿蔔片. (21) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻. (22) [Subtitle]: 加入約600ml的熱水 慢慢煮滾. (23) [Subtitle]: 一旁煮一鍋水 水滾後放入麵條. (24) [Subtitle]: 這邊的湯 也差不多滾了. (25) [Subtitle]: 放入蛤蜊進來 煮到開口即可. (26) [Subtitle]: 麵已經煮好囉！. (27) [Subtitle]: 絲瓜跟蘿蔔 也都熟透了. (28) [Subtitle]: 最後放入鱸魚片. (29) [Subtitle]: 火轉到最小 用泡的方式泡熟. (30) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、一點酒調味. (31) [Subtitle]: 天冷的時候來一碗❤️ 絲瓜蘿蔔鱸魚湯. [Variety]: 自然鮮甜好滋味！. (32) [Slogan]: 用泡的方式煮魚肉 超級嫩嫩❤️. (33) [Variety]: 冷冷的天，熱熱的湯麵 最幸福不過了❤️.

(2) Rhythmic, percussive scraping sounds are heard as the radish is peeled, followed by solid thuds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board. (3) A distinct metallic thud occurs as garlic is smashed, followed by rapid, sharp chopping transients. (4) A high-frequency sizzling sound emerges as ingredients are added to hot oil in a pan. (5) The sound of water being poured is heard as a series of fluid, splashing transients. (6) Bubbling sounds from simmering liquid are consistent. (7) Metallic clinking sounds occur when the strainer and lids are handled. The music remains the primary continuous layer throughout, with environmental cooking sounds layered clearly on top.
